name: a clock ticks through the night while tasks tick off
looks: A big digital clock reads the small hours on a dark field, climbing from one time to the next across hard cuts, with a short task list beside it adding a finished item and a green check each time the hour jumps. By the last cut the clock reads morning and every task sits checked off.
build: Clock digits are plain text set directly from a time value with no easing, one value per cut; each task row fades/rises in with a check-mark pop timed to its own cut, dimming the rows above it slightly so the newest always reads brightest.
sound: A low ambient pad under the dark hold, a soft chime on each new task checking off.
prompt: Show a big digital clock jumping forward through the small hours across hard cuts on a dark field, with a short task list beside it gaining one finished, checked-off item on each jump, so the passage of time and the accumulating work read together.
